name: Guilin Seamild Foods Co., Ltd
summary: Guilin Seamild Foods Co., Ltd engages in the research, development, production, and management of oat cereal and health food products under the Seamild brand in China. It offers plain, organic, milk, breakfast milk, chia seed cereal, fiber rye, wheat cerm, quinoa mixed cereal, and black cereal oatmeal; red bean and coix seed, black sesame and mulberry, nuts, and purple sweet potato and yam oats; and oatmeal walnut powder, peptide oats dietary, probiotic yogurt oats, and high-fiber oat bran.
